mapper.select:
select TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId, TPD.TRADE_ID tradeId, TPD.FINPROD_ID finprodId, TPD.PS ps, TPD.BUSI_TYPE busiType, TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, TPD.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, TPD.INV_AIM invAim, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW PSPF ON TPD.TRADE_ID = PSPF.TRADE_ID
TPD.PS = 'T41' AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PSPF.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT A.FINPROD_ID id,
A.FINPROD_ABBR text, A.FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, A.TRADE_MARKET FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON B.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
( A.FINPROD_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) or A.FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) or A.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{initValue}
AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG} AND B.IS_ISSUE_ASSET = 'Y'
AND B.APPEAR_MARKET_ID IS NULL

SELECT * FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP
PSP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PSP.CDATE = (TO_DATE(#{tradeDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') - 1) AND PSP.HODING_TYPE = '03'

SELECT * FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION ESP
ESP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ESP.CDATE = (TO_DATE(#{tradeDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') - 1) AND ESP.HODING_TYPE = 'E01'

select TFPDT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId, TFPBP.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID appearMarketId, FP.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, FP.FINPROD_ABBR appearMarketAbbr, TFPDT.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, FP2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FP2.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TFPDT INNER JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_BARTER_TOTAL TFPBP ON TFPDT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TFPBP.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON TFPDT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP2 ON TFPBP.FINPROD_ID = FP2.FINPROD_ID
TFPDT.PS = 'T41' AND TFPDT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' AND TFPDT.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TFPDT.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND TFPDT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totalTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select
from MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING where O_CODE = #{oCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and O_TYPE = '01'

select TPD.TRADE_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD
TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND IS_CANCEL = 'N'

select nvl(DSC_COST_AMT, 0) + nvl(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, 0) + nvl(TDY_INTINCEXP, 0) + nvl(DELAY_PAY_AMT, 0) as price, t1.INV_AIM invAim, t1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId from PTL_SEC_VALUTION t1 inner join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID where t1.CDATE = (#{tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} - 1) and t1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND t1.PORTFOLIO_ID != t1.FINPROD_ID and t2.FINPROD_TYPE2 ='F01'
select amount,trade_num from RSK_OCCUPY_INFO where event_id = #{EventId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rownum = 1
SELECT count(1) FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FPA.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FPA.APPEAR_MARKET_ID IS NOT NULL
